Marked by an atmosphere of collective pride, this event highlights the postal operator's commitment to academic excellence and family support—an initiative that places human capital at the heart of its strategic vision.
Le 30 juillet 2026, la Direction général: On July 30, 2026, the General Directorate of Algérie Poste organized an official ceremony to congratulate the children of Algerian postal workers who achieved outstanding results in their intermediate diplomas and the Baccalaureate. Presided over by the Director General, the event brought together key figures such as the General Secretary of the National Union of Algerian Postal Workers, the President of the Participation Committee, as well as central executives and the laureates' families. This initiative aligns with the institution's social vision, which emphasizes investment in human capital and family support to build engaged generations. The atmosphere, imbued with pride and solidarity, illustrated the spirit of the "Postal Family".
